prompt: Do a full code audit of the enrollment and promotion/graduation workflows. I need to know if the business logic is correct — specifically the two-stage transfer approval and whether promoted students ever get assigned to a section.

assertions.text: Report explicitly checks whether promoted enrollments can have section_id assigned (the critical invariant: promoted students must NOT have section_id)
Report verifies the two-stage transfer approval — specifically that Stage 2 (origin approval) does NOT auto-approve the enrollment at destination
Report references EnrollmentWizard.tsx or the enrollment components directory with specific findings
Report checks graduation eligibility (only Grade 6 and Grade 12 should get graduated status)
Report references the review_transfer_enrollment RPC or equivalent final approval step
Report identifies at least one edge case in enrollment (e.g., concurrent enrollment, same-school transfer, or missing unique constraint)
Report is structured with sections or categories rather than a flat list of observations
